Visquez (Japanese: ビスケス Visquez) is the Vermilion City Gym Leader in the absence of Lt. Surge. She gives the to s who defeat her. She specializes in .

==In animation==
Visquez is a character of the day who appeared in the episode Destination: Coronation!.

She first battled a and his with her , eventually emerging victorious. While cleaning up the mess left by the , she received word that a challenger was coming to battle her for the World Coronation Series, who turned out to be . Visquez remembered Ash from his battle against Lt. Surge, and they had a two-on-two battle, with Visquez using her Raichu and against Ash's Pikachu and . The battle ended in Visquez's loss, causing her rank to go down.

Afterwards, Visquez said goodbye to Ash and Goh. She promised Ash that she would tell Lt. Surge about the battle they had and how Ash had evolved as a Trainer since then.

===Character===
Although she is tough, Visquez encourages all of the Trainers she faces to do their best in battle. Despite being a replacement Gym Leader, Visquez is well-respected in Vermilion City.
